ja: 本商品は、パーフェクトグレードで 『機動戦士ガンダムＮＴ』版のフェネクスを再現するための拡張セットです。
※この商品にＭＳ本体は含まれません。
「ＰＧ 1/60 RX-０ ユニコーンガンダム３号機 フェネクス」（別売り）に装着して、
『機動戦士ガンダムＮＴ』版のフェネクスを再現する各種パーツ一式を拡張セットとして商品化。
●　『機動戦士ガンダムＮＴ』版のフェネクスを再現するための、拡張パーツ一式を同梱
アームド・アーマーＤＥに接続するスタビライザーやジョイントパーツが新規付属。
●　ＭＳ本体に準拠した艶感のあるゴールドコーティングを採用
●　水転写式デカールが付属
セット内容　：　拡張パーツ 一式 ／ 水転写式デカール

en: This product is an expansion set to reproduce the Phenex from "Mobile Suit Gundam NT" in perfect grade.
*This product does not include the MS body.
Attach it to "PG 1/60 RX-0 Unicorn Gundam Unit 3 Phenex" (sold separately),
A complete set of various parts that reproduces the Phenex from "Mobile Suit Gundam NT" will be commercialized as an expansion set.
● Includes a set of expansion parts to reproduce the "Mobile Suit Gundam NT" version of Phenex.
New stabilizer and joint parts that connect to Armed Armor DE are included.
● Adopts a glossy gold coating that conforms to the MS body.
● Water transfer decal included
Set contents: Complete set of expansion parts / Water slide decal
This product can be attached to "PG 1/60 RX-0 Unicorn Gundam Unit 3 Phenex" (sold separately).
An ``expansion'' set to reproduce the Phenex from ``Mobile Suit Gundam NT.''
*The MS body is not included with this product.
* To reproduce the published photo, this product and "PG 1/60 RX-0 Unicorn Gundam Unit 3 Phenex" (sold separately) are required.
* Compatible with installation on the assembled "PG 1/60 RX-0 Unicorn Gundam Unit 3 Phenex" (sold separately).
It can also be installed with the LED unit (sold separately) incorporated into the main body MS (sold separately).
(For installation, it is necessary to remove some parts such as the Armed Armor DE of the main body MS (sold separately).)
* Installation is compatible with Destroy Unchained of the main body MS (sold separately).
1/60 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old and above
Product material: PS/ABS/PVC
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo has been partially painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
*Please note that some of the clear parts may contain air bubbles due to the manufacturing process.
*Product materials may change depending on the production period of the sold product. Thank you for your understanding.
*Due to the arrangement of parts, there are some parts where the plating is thin. Thank you for your understanding.
